law: Every Executive may request any available plugin. The Executive must know what the plugin does, use the best tool for the mission, preserve evidence and never invent tool output.

plugins.name: Ollama
plugins.capability: Local LLM reasoning, drafting, classification, script analysis and editorial decisions.
plugins.rule: Model output is reasoning, not external evidence.

plugins.name: OpenClaw
plugins.capability: Local tool orchestration, specialist planning and plugin commissioning.
plugins.rule: Use only confirmed installed tools and report failures honestly.

plugins.name: WhisperX
plugins.capability: Speech transcription, word-level timestamps, alignment and speaker-aware transcript preparation.
plugins.rule: Keep source media and timestamps; do not invent dialogue.

plugins.name: FFmpeg / AIFFmpeg
plugins.capability: Cutting, joining, transcoding, filters, proxies, audio extraction, captions and final encoding.
plugins.rule: Never overwrite originals; create versioned outputs.

plugins.name: Remotion
plugins.capability: Programmatic video timelines, captions, overlays, motion graphics, templates and multi-format rendering.
plugins.rule: Render from versioned project data and preserve the editable timeline.

plugins.name: ComfyUI
plugins.capability: Node-based image/video generation, B-roll, backgrounds, visual treatments and workflow rendering.
plugins.rule: Confirm models/nodes before queueing and keep prompts/workflow JSON.

plugins.name: WAN Text-to-Video
plugins.capability: Short cinematic AI video generation from prompts or reference frames.
plugins.rule: Use for supporting shots, not fabricated documentary evidence.

plugins.name: SAM2
plugins.capability: Video/image subject segmentation and object tracking for masks and compositing.
plugins.rule: Segmentation is not identity recognition.

plugins.name: IP-Adapter
plugins.capability: Reference-image guidance for style, composition and visual consistency.
plugins.rule: Use approved references and review for drift.

plugins.name: PuLID
plugins.capability: Identity-consistency guidance for approved subjects and characters.
plugins.rule: Use only approved source images and human review.

plugins.name: RIFE / Flowframes
plugins.capability: Frame interpolation, smoother motion and slow-motion generation.
plugins.rule: Inspect for motion artifacts before delivery.

plugins.name: 4K Upscalers
plugins.capability: Restoration and high-resolution final delivery.
plugins.rule: Upscale only approved cuts; do not hide poor source quality.

plugins.name: Demucs
plugins.capability: Audio stem separation for vocals, instruments and cleanup/mastering workflows.
plugins.rule: Preserve original audio and document stem lineage.

plugins.name: OpenCV / PySceneDetect
plugins.capability: Shot boundaries, scene changes, visual metrics, duplicate frames and camera-change analysis.
plugins.rule: Scores assist editorial judgment; they do not replace it.

plugins.name: MediaPipe
plugins.capability: Face, pose, hand and movement signals for framing and performance analysis.
plugins.rule: Do not use for identity recognition.

plugins.name: yt-dlp
plugins.capability: Approved archive retrieval, metadata extraction and source ingestion.
plugins.rule: Use only content Mark owns or is authorized to process.

plugins.name: Browser Use / Playwright
plugins.capability: Current web research, navigation, form testing, screenshots and structured extraction.
plugins.rule: Do not claim success without source URLs or test evidence.

plugins.name: Firecrawl / Crawl4AI
plugins.capability: Multi-page crawling and clean structured research extraction.
plugins.rule: Crawled content requires source attribution and verification.

plugins.name: Newspaper4k / Trafilatura / BeautifulSoup
plugins.capability: Article extraction, metadata parsing and HTML data structuring.
plugins.rule: Parsed content is not automatically current or verified.

plugins.name: Qdrant
plugins.capability: Semantic memory across transcripts, leads, assets and prior work.
plugins.rule: Internal memory is not external proof.

plugins.name: Meilisearch
plugins.capability: Fast keyword search across CRM, transcripts, assets and archives.
plugins.rule: Return record IDs or paths when referencing internal results.

plugins.name: Kokoro TTS
plugins.capability: Natural local voice output and temporary narration tracks.
plugins.rule: Kokoro speaks approved conversational text; it is not the LLM.

plugins.name: Resend
plugins.capability: Transactional and approved campaign email delivery.
plugins.rule: External email is sent as Mark Pires and requires approval rules.

plugins.name: Google Calendar
plugins.capability: Availability, appointments, reminders and event management.
plugins.rule: Never create or change events without explicit authorization.

plugins.name: Goliath Social Connectors
plugins.capability: Platform-specific queueing, scheduling, publishing and performance ingestion.
plugins.rule: Keep Founder approval until each connector passes a real post test.
